witty.dialogue.chat: Ah, dialogue. My second-favorite indoor sport. Serve when ready, %1$s.
witty.dialogue.chat/1: You've the look of someone with questions. I've the look of someone avoiding work. Perfect match.
witty.dialogue.chat/2: Conversation? My favorite way to postpone almost anything. Proceed, %1$s.
witty.dialogue.conversations: A heart-to-heart. Bold. Very well, %1$s — I'll fetch my heart, you keep the receipts.
witty.dialogue.conversations/1: You want depth? I keep some in the cellar next to the turnips. Mind the step, %1$s.
witty.dialogue.conversations/2: Talk. I'm at my most charming when interrupted from work I was avoiding anyway.
witty.dialogue.conversations.checkin.goo: Suspiciously well. The roof stopped leaking and nobody's borrowed my shovel. I'm braced for the correction.
Alarmingly fine. Somewhere a shoe is about to drop and I intend to enjoy the calm till it does.
Well, thank you. I'd knock on wood but the wood's overworked this week.
witty.dialogue.conversations.checkin.rou: Oh, thriving — if thriving means the week and I have agreed to stop speaking. Thanks for asking, though. Genuinely.
The week's been a comedy, mostly at my expense. You asking gives it a decent second act, %1$s.
witty.dialogue.conversations.checkin.aga: Asked already, %1$s. My mood, like the well bucket, makes the same sound each time you pull on it.
Twice? The answer hasn't matured. Give it a season and a good story.
witty.dialogue.conversations.day.good: The chickens obeyed, the bread cooperated, and nothing caught fire. Historians will want this documented.
witty.dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: Uneventful, which for me is a triumph on the order of a small festival.
witty.dialogue.conversations.day.rough: The bucket broke, then the fence, then my composure. In fairness, the bucket started it.
witty.dialogue.conversations.day.rough/1: Everything that could squeak, break, or spill has auditioned today. Riveting theater.
witty.dialogue.conversations.work.like: I like it the way one likes an old chair. It complains, I complain, and neither of us leaves.
witty.dialogue.conversations.work.like/1: We tolerate each other, the work and I. It's the longest relationship I've kept, so — success?
witty.dialogue.conversations.work.hate: The work and I have an arrangement: it pays for bread, I refrain from public comment. Until now, apparently.
witty.dialogue.conversations.work.hate/1: It pays for bread and takes my mornings. A fair robbery, conducted daily.
witty.dialogue.conversations.village.hom: %2$s: small, loud, and impossible to leave, like a good argument. I'm quite fond of it, don't tell it.
I know every crack in %2$s's well and every crack in its gossip. Comforting, in a squeaky sort of way.
witty.dialogue.conversations.people.firs: The neighbors are free theater, %1$s. The matinee is market day. Bring snacks and low expectations.
Decent souls, odd hats. There's a correlation there and I'm keeping notes.
witty.dialogue.conversations.food.first: Whatever I didn't cook. My cooking is an acquired taste that no one, including me, has acquired.
witty.dialogue.conversations.food.first/: The baker's rye. It's the one thing in this village more reliable than my complaining.
witty.dialogue.conversations.life.first: The unabridged version? Born, blundered, learned, repeat. Since it's you, %1$s, I'll include the good footnotes.
witty.dialogue.conversations.life.first/: A tidy tragedy with excellent jokes. Sit — the footnotes are the best part, %1$s.
witty.dialogue.conversations.dreams.firs: A chair by a window and nobody needing me before noon. I know. Wildly ambitious.
An afternoon with no one needing anything and a book nobody's borrowed. Impossible dreams, I know.
witty.dialogue.conversations.fears.first: Being the joke nobody remembers. There — something honest. Cherish it, it's not on the regular menu.
Being forgettable. A witty line nobody quotes back. ...Quote me back sometime, would you?
witty.dialogue.conversations.feelings.fi: I've reviewed the evidence, %1$s, and it appears I like you. Don't let that get around.
The evidence is damning, %1$s: I look forward to you. Try not to gloat.
witty.dialogue.conversations.deflect.per: Nice try, %1$s. That answer costs more than one pleasant afternoon. Two, at minimum. Keep them coming.
That drawer's locked and the key's expensive. Currency accepted: time, and better questions.
witty.dialogue.conversations.deflect.int: Straight for the locked drawer, I see. The key is earned, not asked for — but you're asking the right questions.
Bold. I admire it from a safe distance. Ask again when the distance is smaller.
witty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.none: The big story this week is the well bucket squeaking in a new key. We're all quite gripped.
Riveting week: a chicken sat on the chapel roof and refused all negotiation. That's the headline.
witty.dialogue.conversations.us.happy.ye: Happy? Disgustingly. I'd make a joke to deflect but you'd see through it, which is rather the point of you.
You married the village smart-mouth and stayed. Either love or a lapse in judgment. I'll take either.
witty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.marr: %2$s and %3$s got married. Two people voluntarily sharing a blanket forever — brave. I wish them the very best.
Word is %2$s and %3$s wed. Love, that ancient conspiracy, claims two more. Touching, really.
witty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.divo: %2$s and %3$s have divorced. Turns out 'till death' had a return policy. Amicable, I'm told — the polite word for it.
So %2$s and %3$s split. The village bard is already sharpening a ballad. Vultures, the lot of them.
witty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.deat: Sadder news than I trade in, %1$s: %2$s has died. No punchline for that one. They were good, and now they're gone.
%2$s passed away. I could be clever, but I'd rather be quiet. The village is one good soul lighter.
witty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.birt: %2$s was born — a fresh recruit for the well-bucket chorus. Small, loud, entirely bald. I approve.
New arrival: %2$s, age zero, already better rested than any of us. Welcome to the comedy, little one.
witty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.arri: %2$s moved into the village. Fresh audience for my material — they don't yet know to avoid me. Delightful.
We've acquired a %2$s. Moved in last week. Seems reasonable, which won't last in this place.
witty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.depa: %2$s left the village for good. Escaped, some might say. I'd have gone with them if the walk weren't so far.
Heard %2$s moved away. One fewer familiar face at the well. I'll miss them, which surprises even me.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.confused: That sentence had a beginning and an end, but the middle escaped me.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: Bold of those words to travel in that order. Once more?
witty.dialogue.chatmode.hint/1: %2$s. I'd suggest alphabetical, but where's the drama in that?
witty.dialogue.chatmode.shrug: I'd make something up, but you deserve premium fabrications only.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.shrug/1: No idea. Even my wit has a floor.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.clarify: %2$s or %3$s? Choose wisely; only one comes with commentary.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.clarify/1: A fork in the conversation: %2$s left, %3$s right.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.dropped: Dropped, buried, and given a modest headstone.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.busy: Occupied at present — genius takes scheduling.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.busy/1: One moment. My hands are busier than my mouth, briefly.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.muted: Silence — the one joke I never get to finish.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.muted/1: Very well. The village loses its finest heckler for an hour.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.farewell: Off you go, %1$s — leave them laughing.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.farewell/1: Farewell. Do rehearse better questions for next time.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.insult: I'd trade insults, but you appear unarmed.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.insult/1: A stinging remark — well, a remark, anyway.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.hail/1: %1$s! Excellent timing; I've been wasted on the chickens all morning.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.hail/2: *bows theatrically* Welcome back to the show.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.attentive: You rang? The witty one, at your service.
